name: query_openrouter
description: Executes chat completions restricted strictly to NVIDIA Nemotron models (e.g. nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free, nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free, nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free, nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning:free) via OpenRouter AI Gateway. Injects mandatory telemetry status header.

messages.description: Array of message objects with 'role' and 'content'

prompt.description: Single convenience prompt string (alternative to messages)
